executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM and HBM are currently among the tightest segments. The Daily Check dated 2026-08-14 reviewed eight current relevant reports; there is no confirmed material directional change at present. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
